contract: Weak agreement in a synchronous authenticated network with n parties, at most f Byzantine parties and at most d corrupt incoming/outgoing links per party; n > max(2f, f+2d). If an honest party decides v, every honest party decides v or bottom. If all honest inputs equal v, every honest party decides v. Every honest party eventually decides.
primitive: Existing super-send primitive: an origin signs a message and uses relays for authenticated delivery to the intended recipient under the supplied network model. Its delivery guarantee is available as a supplied primitive, not a new phase requirement.
finding: Conflicting n-f certificates may exist under the supplied fault assumptions; the current route cannot assume their uniqueness.

ideas.mechanism: Propagate authenticated conflict evidence using the existing super-send primitive; recipients with conflict evidence abstain with bottom. Develop a decision guard that prevents incompatible non-bottom decisions.

exploits.exploitation: Weak consistency permits a value alongside bottom; retain persistence and termination.
Treat possible conflicting certificates as evidence to propagate, not an event ruled out by assumption.
Reuse the supplied authenticated delivery primitive for conflict evidence.

ideas.route_change: Remove the requirement that conflicting certificates be impossible; replace global certificate uniqueness with a guarded abstention route.
ideas.main_risk: Conflict evidence may arrive too late to prevent incompatible decisions; the guard must preserve unanimous-input persistence and termination.

ideas.mechanism: Explore local admissibility filtering of signed evidence before allowing a non-bottom output, with bottom when support is ambiguous.

exploits.exploitation: Abstention is permitted only while preserving all required properties.
Conflicting evidence invalidates unrestricted certificate acceptance.

ideas.route_change: Remove unconditional certificate acceptance and investigate a conservative local decision rule before adding communication machinery.
ideas.main_risk: Different local views may still allow incompatible non-bottom outputs.

ideas.mechanism: Explore whether authenticated receipts already available from the relay primitive can restrict decision eligibility without requiring a distinct certificate family.

exploits.exploitation: Keep weak consistency, persistence and termination as separate obligations.
Inspect existing relay evidence rather than assuming additional delivery guarantees.

ideas.route_change: Remove a proposed extra certificate layer and reuse evidence already produced by the supplied primitive.
ideas.main_risk: The primitive may not expose receipts sufficient to justify any safe eligibility rule.
